provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Blood on the Clocktower rules (The Pandemonium Institute, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Chairs in a rough circle with one gap for the Storyteller; keep the center clear
Stand the Grimoire where no player can see inside; info, night and shroud tokens in it
Choose an edition and put its box in the Grimoire
steps.note: Start with Trouble Brewing (5+ players); other editions need 7+

steps.text: Town Square in the center: a life token per player, a pile of vote tokens, the Traveler sheet tucked under it
Read the rules sheet to new players and show the hand signals
Secretly pick Townsfolk, Outsiders, Minions and the Demon in the numbers the setup sheet gives for your player count
For each chosen token with an orange leaf, change the line-up as its text in square brackets says
First night, 7+ players: show the Minions the Demon, then show the Demon the Minions and 3 good characters not in play
Night sheet on its First Night side; tell all players to close their eyes
